How the 75-question mock maps to the real exam. Score 80 percent or more under timed conditions before you book. Source: original figure for the AWS AIP-C01 Study Guide. How to read this diagram. Take the mock in one sitting: 75 questions in 180 minutes. Count one point per question only if you picked every correct option and nothing else. At 80 percent or more (60 of 75), book the exam. Below 70 percent, revisit the domains you missed most. Re-attempt their bank questions, then take the mock again. 75-Question Full Mock Exam
